question: Who among the following acts as the chairman of the Planning Commission of the state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chief Minister**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Chief Minister** of a state acts as the chairman of the **State Planning Commission**.
 
• The State Planning Commission is responsible for **formulating state-specific development plans** in alignment with national goals.
 
• The Chief Minister holds the primary executive authority in the state and ensures coordination among various departments for implementing developmental schemes.
 
• State Planning Commissions were modeled after the erstwhile Planning Commission of India, which has now been replaced by the **NITI Aayog** at the central level.
 
• The Chief Minister’s role as chairman signifies the significance of their leadership in state development initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Planning Commission of India**

 
 
• Established in 1950, the Planning Commission was responsible for India’s **five-year plans** and socio-economic development strategies.
 
• It was replaced in 2015 by the **NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India)**.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**
 
 
• NITI Aayog is a **policy think tank** of the Government of India that focuses on fostering cooperative federalism.
 
• It provides strategic and technical advice to both the central and state governments.
 
 
 
• **Chief Minister**
 
 
• The Chief Minister is the head of the state government and is appointed by the Governor.
 
• They are responsible for the overall administration and development of the state.
 
 
 
• **State Planning Boards/Commissions**
 
 
• These are advisory bodies that assist in planning and implementing development initiatives at the state level.
 
• They work closely with the respective Chief Ministers and state departments.
